summary: Piotr Balcerowicz is an Indologist and philosopher who earned his degrees from the University of Warsaw, Banaras Hindu University, the University of Hamburg, and the Polish Academy of Sciences. He has held professorships at SWPS University and the University of Warsaw.

Piotr Klafkowski (1953–2002) worked in Tibetology and linguistics. He earned his PhD at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań under Jerzy Bańczerowski, having also studied under Lobsang Jamspal, Geshe Geleg Gyatsho, and Jampa Kelzang Rinpoche.

Po Lu Khenpo Dorjé (1897–1970) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and later taught Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche and Chagdud Tulku Rinpoche.

Poerbatjaraka (1884–1964) was an Indonesian scholar of linguistics, Indology, and history and archaeology. After earning his doctorate at Leiden University under Nicolaas Johannes Krom, he served as a professor at Gadjah Mada University, the University of Indonesia, and Udayana University.

Polly Young-Eisendrath is a scholar of Buddhist studies and religious studies who was educated at Ohio University, Goddard College, and Washington University in St. Louis. In 1994, she became a clinical associate professor in psychiatry at the University of Vermont.

Popatbhai Ambashankar Mankad was a scholar in Indology, history, and archaeology. His career included serving as State Engineer in Junagadh, Chief Engineer for Jodhpur State, and Chief Officer and Engineer for the Hyderabad Municipality.
Pori Park is a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies who studied under Robert E. Buswell Jr. She has served as an assistant professor of religious studies at Arizona State University.

Potprecha Cholvijarn is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who earned degrees from Chulalongkorn University and the University of Bristol, studying under Rupert Gethin. He was attested as a special lecturer at Chulalongkorn University in 2011.
Poulami Ray is a history and archaeology researcher who studied under doctoral supervisor Ranjit Sen. She is attested as a research scholar and fellow at The Asiatic Society in 2026.
Prabal Kumar Sen is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who held posts at the Ramakrishna Mission Institute of Culture and the University of Calcutta, where he was attested as a professor in 2009.
Prabhasa Dharma (1931–1999) was a Buddhist studies and religious studies practitioner and scholar who completed traditional training under Joshu Sasaki beginning in 1967 and under Seikaku Hirata.

Prabodh Chandra Bagchi (1898–1956) was an Indologist, Buddhist studies scholar, and sinologist who completed a doctorate at the University of Paris under Sylvain Lévi. He held professorships at the University of Calcutta, Peking University, and Visva-Bharati University.
Pragati Sahni is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied under Damien Keown. She is attested as an associate professor at the University of Delhi in 2026.
Praggnaparamita Biswas is an Indology researcher who studied under doctoral supervisor Ratna Basu. She is attested as a research scholar and fellow at The Asiatic Society in 2026.

Prahlad Pradhan (1910–1982) was a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies educated at Patna University and Visva-Bharati University. He held academic posts at Gangadhar Meher University, Utkal University, and Shri Jagannath Sanskrit Vishvavidyalaya.

Pramod Chandra (1930–2016) was an art historian and Indologist who earned his PhD from the University of Mumbai. He served as a professor at the University of Chicago and later as Bickford Professor at Harvard University from 1980 to 2004.

Pramod P. Joglekar is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He served on the Regulating Council of the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (2020–2025) and is attested in 2026 as Professor of Bioarchaeology at Deccan College.

Prasanna Venkatesh T S works in computational studies and Indology. He has held posts at the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, and as a PhD research scholar at Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College.
Prasarn Lao-areun is a scholar in philosophy and Indology who studied under Viroj Inthanon and completed a PhD attested in 2014 at the University of Mysore.

Pratap Chandra Chunder (1919–2008) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at Hindu School, Presidency University, and the University of Calcutta, where he was taught by Prabodh Chandra Bagchi.
